deployments_detail.use: "Zara Try-On" AI-generated virtual fitting-room images (launched Dec 2025); AI-optimized supply chain

Zara Try-on: generative-AI virtual fitting room in the Zara app/website that builds a synthetic avatar from a customer's own photos and generates images of that avatar wearing real products, to reduce returns and improve online conversion. [not disclosed]
deployments_detail.value: Deployed in 43 markets; 7M+ sessions since mid-December launch; rolling out to other Inditex brands

deployments_detail.use: Generative-AI fashion photography that digitally dresses real human models in different garments for e-commerce product imagery, cutting studio/shoot production time. [not disclosed]
deployments_detail.value: E-commerce photo production cut from ~11 days to under 48 hours; ~35% reduction in shoot-related expenses

deployments_detail.use: Jetlore AI-powered consumer-behavior prediction platform used to map shopper behavior into predictive attributes (size, color, fit, style) for personalization and size/fit recommendations. [Jetlore]

"What's My Size?" / Find Your Size online tool that recommends the best size from a shopper's body measurements and fit preferences plus data from similar-sized customers, to reduce fit-related returns. [not disclosed]

SINT integrated stock-management system paired with machine-learning models that determine the optimum stock each point of sale should hold, enabling hyper-local demand-driven allocation and fulfilling online orders from store and online stockrooms. [in-house (location-based AI/ML)]
deployments_detail.value: Reported ~20% reduction in overstock vs 2023 levels (per industry analysis)

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven trend detection / social listening analyzing hashtags, search patterns and social signals to spot emerging fashion trends and feed design and merchandising decisions. [not disclosed]

Machine-learning new-product demand forecasting and distribution optimization developed via research collaboration with MIT, predicting demand for newly launched items using data from similar products and store clusters. [MIT (research collaboration)]

Warehouse/logistics automation with Fetch Robotics autonomous robots for stock inventory handling and Intel devices to measure clothing volume in boxes, developed through Inditex's innovation unit. [Fetch Robotics; Intel]
"Anomalies with Context" project that uses algorithms to analyze transaction data and flag suspicious/anomalous activity for fraud prevention and loss control. [in-house]
